scenario.name: r-cd-return-covenant-authority
scenario.description: Return-covenant authority must survive a gateway-restart transition: the current generation may not be cleared before its replacement is usable, and the transition's failure body must be retained rather than lost.
scenario.notes: Construct-only. Ledger command AUTHORITY-RESTART-CONTROL, state missing, gate reviewed-restart-control-on-final-successor. The rejected base is that the first gateway-restart transition cleared the current generation before the replacement became usable and the exact failure body was lost. The only attempt on record is historical-baseline-review: the repaired launcher reached readiness and read-only mounts, but fixture gateway phase calls failed, yielding zero of 24 observations and no signed cleanup/observer receipt. The corpus row therefore holds EVIDENCE.md alone, so there are no committed artifacts for a static validator to parse and no validators[rowId] implementation exists in scenarios/static-corpus-row-validator.js. Binding it to that generic validator would fail closed on a missing implementation rather than record the row's real state, so it is declared non-runnable until a successor restart control exists.
scenario.registryNotes: Catalogued to close a fail-closed gap: check-proof-row-manifests.mjs requires every corpus row to carry a manifest, and this row had none, which blocked every catalog-mode proof run rather than only this row.

expectedReceipts.name: transition-http-body
expectedReceipts.description: The gateway-restart transition's HTTP response body is retained; the rejected base lost it.

expectedReceipts.name: replacement-process-output
expectedReceipts.description: Replacement process stdout and stderr are captured across the transition.

expectedReceipts.name: generation-fingerprints
expectedReceipts.description: Old and new process and socket fingerprints identify both generations across the restart.

expectedReceipts.name: observation-record
expectedReceipts.description: Observations are recorded for the restart case; the baseline attempt produced zero of twenty-four.

expectedReceipts.name: signed-cleanup-receipt
expectedReceipts.description: A signed cleanup and observer receipt closes the case; the baseline attempt produced none.

review.notes: Declaring this row in the catalog records its state; it does not promote it. The row remains MISSING until a reviewed restart control runs on the final successor product.

liveRunSafety.notes: Construct-only rows are rejected by the live-run guard, so cataloguing this row cannot cause it to fire. A future live restart control requires its own review before any fold.
